sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
Learned counsel for the State has filed counter affidavit today in the Court which is taken on record.
Para-4 of the affidavit reflects that notice has been served upon the first informant.
Despite service of notice upon the first informant, no one appears on behalf of the first informant even in the revised list.

2. Heard Sri V.K. Baranwal, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ajay Singh, learned counsel for the State and perused the material on record.
3.

This bail application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant-Jitendra Saroj, seeking enlargement on bail during trial in connection with Case Crime No. 506 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC & Section 3/4 POCSO Act, registered at P.S.
Jitendra Saroj vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64867588/
1 Nawabganj, District Prayagraj.
4.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The first information report of the present case was lodged on 20.08.202 under Section 363, 366 IPC by Smt. Kusma Devi alleging therein that her daughter aged about 16 years went missing from 18.08.2022 since 4:00 PM.
There is suspicion that Farhan has enticed the victim away by luring her.
She was searched a lot but could not trace her out, thus, the present FIR was lodged.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is argued that the applicant is not named in the FIR.
It is argued that the victim was recovered on 21.08.2022 after which she was taken to the doctor but she refused for medical examination and as such her age also could not be determined.
It is argued that the prosecution relies on the date of birth of the victim as recorded in the school pertaining to Class-8 which is not proper record as per law.

It is argued that in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., victim for the first time took the name of the applicant and stated that she was in touch with the applicant for the last two months and she went with him as her family members used to beat her.
She stated that the applicant has established physical relations with her twice.
In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she stated that the applicant forcibly taken her on a motorcycle and committed rape upon her.
It is argued that there is serious contradiction in the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C..
It is argued that age of the victim even if presumed to be 16 years and by giving benefit of variation of two years, she would be a major.
It is argued that the prosecutrix was produced before the doctor but she reused her medical examination.
It is argued that the applicant has no criminal history as stated in para 17 of the affidavit and is in jail since 23.08.2022.
6. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and argued that during investigation Section 376 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act were added.
It is further argued that the victim is minor, as such, bail application be dismissed.

7. After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that there are serious contradiction in the statements of victim recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C..
The victim denied to get her medically examined for age determination.

8. Looking to the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of evidence and also the absence of any convincing material to indicate the possibility of tampering with the evidence, this Court is of the view that the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

9. Let the applicant Jitendra Saroj, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim/complainant in any manner whatsoever.
Jitendra Saroj vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64867588/
2 ii) The applicant will abide the orders of court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.

entities.text: Jitendra Saroj vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under section 82 Cr.P.C., may be issued and if applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under section 174-A I.P.C.
(V) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against her in accordance with law and the trial court may proceed against her under Section 229-A IPC.

(vi) The trial court may make all possible efforts/endeavour and try to conclude the trial expeditiously after the release of the applicant.
10. The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
11. The bail application is allowed.
Order Date :- 20.7.2023 Mukesh Kr.
(Samit Gopal,J.)
